description:
In 1940, during a time of chaos, a man built a beautiful mansion on a remote island, Yeongchunhwa, solely for the sake of his wife whom he loved deeply. After a long time, the story of the couple involved in the mansion was forgotten, but one day, a mysterious 'manager' appeared and operated it as a lodging facility. He began inviting people who must love to the mansion, following the couple's souls...! 

 *"Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, a secret mansion that will bring you endless imagination. Any form of love is possible here. Love and indulge to your heart's content. As long as the mansion allows."*

A luxurious mansion and people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women drawn by various writers are unfolding now.

**Third Short Story *I've Loved You All Along:*** Do Han-Gyeol and Lee Sa-Rang win a free stay at the Yeongchunhwa Mansion through a university festival event. Though strangers, Sa-Rang's proactive attitude towards love soon leads them to the mansion.

 *“I like you... I've liked you since the moment we met...!”*

There, Han-Gyeol receives Sa-Rang's passionate confession. In truth, Han-Gyeol possesses the ability to hear the lies of anyone he touches. But strangely, Sa-Rang's lies remain inaudible. Every whisper of confession from her mouth holds not a shred of falsehood. 

*‘This can't be... What is this woman's true intention...?’*

A woman pouring out her love and a man afraid to begin it. Where will this relationship lead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
